data.name: Aadheen
data.gender_notes: Aadheen is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Recorded in Muslim name-lists as 'obedient, submissive'. It is connected with the Arabic root ʾ-dh-n (permission, hearing), though the exact derivation of this name form is not settled in the sources consulted. Aadheen therefore means “Obedient; submissive; compliant”. Muslim name-lists record Aadheen as 'obedient, submissive'; the derivation is not settled in the sources consulted.
